inspected.author: James Karki / Texas Instruments
inspected.title: Signal Conditioning Piezoelectric Sensors
inspected.observation: Charge balance, feedback bleed and finite impedances support the existing independent charge oracle. Piezoelectric mechanics and circuit performance are not condenser-microphone results.

inspected.author: Texas Instruments
inspected.title: OPA928 datasheet
inspected.observation: 16V/8V fixture matches midpoint reference conditions. Near-rail operation cannot inherit midpoint noise/guard specifications. Internal guard can be left floating with an external driver. Guard headroom, isolation and board leakage require separate controls.

inspected.author: ngspice project
inspected.title: ngspice User's Manual
inspected.observation: Manual distinguishes seeded source injection from stationary device noise. PSS is experimental; section11.3.12 also describes it as not publicly available. This documentation does not establish a supported periodically biased device-noise analysis for Meridian.
inspected.crosscheck_limit: Release47 news mentions a PSS update; the manual's availability statement alone is not an executable capability test. No new solver/PSS/noise run was performed in this audit.

inspected.author: Joel Phillips and Ken Kundert
inspected.title: Noise in Mixers, Oscillators, Samplers, and Logic: An Introduction to Cyclostationary Noise
inspected.revision: Version1a, May2000; front matter last updated10March2019; see original receipt for exact bytes
inspected.observation: Periodic translation and folding retain the need for sideband covariance. Existing seeded LPTV arm sources do not establish noise spectra under periodic transistor bias.
